subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Then they got used to the correct time.”?
options: It reminded Mr. Huang that not every problem needs to be fixed in the same way it was before.
After that day, the family made a rule: before sharing shocking news, check the date, the source, and whether trusted reports say the same thing.
Human comfort matters, but so do the needs of small lives that disappear when nights become too bright.
The clock did not change their lives greatly, but it reminded them that comfort and correctness are not always the same thing.
